AIIMS Nagpur is the All India Institute of Medical Sciences located in MIHAN, Nagpur, Maharashtra. It provides healthcare, medical education and research services.
AIIMS Nagpur is located at Plot No. 2, Sector-20, MIHAN, Nagpur, Maharashtra.
The AIIMS Nagpur campus is located in MIHAN, Nagpur, Maharashtra. The address is Plot No. 2, Sector-20, MIHAN, Nagpur.
AIIMS Nagpur official helpline: 9404044944. IPD Control Room: 0712-2352078 / 0712-2352030. Please verify current contact details from the official AIIMS Nagpur website.
AIIMS Nagpur Trauma and Emergency services are available 24×7. If you have a serious or life-threatening situation, seek emergency medical care immediately.
The AIIMS Nagpur Trauma and Emergency service is available 24×7. For an emergency, do not wait for a routine OPD appointment.
OPD means Outpatient Department. It is where patients visit for consultation without hospital admission. AIIMS Nagpur provides OPD services across different specialties.
AIIMS Nagpur General and Medicine OPD is listed as Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM and Saturday, 9:00 AM–1:00 PM. Trauma and Emergency services are available 24×7.

AIIMS Nagpur has multiple departments including General Medicine, General Surgery, Cardiology, Dermatology, Neurology, Neurosurgery, Nephrology, Pulmonary Medicine, Gastroenterology, Urology, Psychiatry, Oncology, ENT, Radiodiagnosis and Trauma & Emergency.
For heart-related problems, Cardiology is the relevant specialty. AIIMS Nagpur has a Cardiology department. For severe or sudden chest pain, seek emergency medical care immediately.
For skin-related problems, Dermatology is the appropriate specialty. AIIMS Nagpur has a Dermatology department. A doctor should examine the condition before recommending treatment.
For kidney-related problems, Nephrology is the relevant specialty. AIIMS Nagpur has a Nephrology department. Please consult a qualified doctor before taking any medicine.
For neurological problems, Neurology is the relevant specialty. AIIMS Nagpur has Neurology services. Please consult a doctor for proper assessment.
For persistent or specific digestive and stomach-related problems, Gastroenterology may be appropriate. General Medicine can also provide an initial assessment and refer you if needed.
For lung and respiratory problems, Pulmonary Medicine is the relevant specialty. If breathing difficulty is severe or worsening, seek emergency care immediately.

For a doctor consultation, you can use the official AIIMS Nagpur OPD/registration facility. Please check the current appointment and registration procedure before visiting because availability can change.
AIIMS Nagpur campus information lists an AMRUT Pharmacy. For the current pharmacy location and availability, please confirm with the hospital helpdesk.

For fever, please consult a doctor rather than taking medicine based on chatbot advice. General Medicine at AIIMS Nagpur can provide an initial assessment. The doctor can decide whether tests or medicines are required.
For cough or cold symptoms, please consult a doctor rather than self-prescribing medicine. General Medicine can provide an initial assessment and guide you to another specialty if required.

Chest pain can require urgent medical assessment. If the pain is severe, sudden or worsening, seek emergency medical care immediately. AIIMS Nagpur Trauma and Emergency services are available 24×7. This chatbot does not diagnose or prescribe medicines.
Breathing difficulty may require prompt medical assessment. If it is severe or worsening, seek emergency care immediately. AIIMS Nagpur Trauma and Emergency services are available 24×7.
For stomach or abdominal symptoms, please consult a doctor. General Medicine can provide an initial assessment and refer you to Gastroenterology if required. The chatbot does not prescribe medicines.
For recurring or concerning headaches, please consult a doctor for proper assessment. General Medicine can provide an initial evaluation and refer you to Neurology if required.
For dental problems, please seek consultation from an appropriate dental service. A qualified dental professional should examine the problem before recommending treatment.
